question: How many mass shootings will the U.S. experience in August 2026?

factors.description: August 2025 MST count was 46; 2026 YTD running ~7% above comparable 2025 period implies Aug 2026 near 48-52, favoring 46-55 bucket
Recent August declining trend (68->61->46) and low June 2026 (45) pull toward mid-40s to low-50s
July 2026 elevated (~79 full month); Jul->Aug ratio ~0.76 implies ~60, giving upside to 56-65
August has no major holiday (unlike July 4th) so tends to revert from July spike toward baseline low-50s

summary: Forecasting August 2026 US mass shootings per the Mass Shooting Tracker (MST, broadest 4+-shot-including-shooter definition). I pulled authoritative monthly counts directly from MST's S3 JSON data. 2026 monthly: Jan34, Feb36, Mar43, Apr42, May48, Jun45, Jul74 (partial through Jul 27). Recent Augusts declined sharply: 2023=68, 2024=61, 2025=46. 2026 YTD (322) runs ~7% above the comparable 2025 period. A Monte Carlo mixture of three estimation approaches — year-over-year scaling (~50), July-to-August ratio (~0.76 × ~79 full-July ≈ 60), and continued-decline trend (~44) — centers August 2026 near 51, mode in the 46-55 bucket with substantial mass on adjacent buckets. Genuine uncertainty from the low-June/high-July tension, but August's lack of a major holiday favors reversion toward the low-50s.
